findings.acceptance: Reviewer can view the map and its assets without playing it.
findings.raw_368: UserMapResponse/getModerationQueue can include mapData and reportsCount but contain no uploaded-asset field/query.
findings.required: Expose author-uploaded graphics/assets with the moderation preview.

findings.raw_368: reportMap writes user_map_reports and then separately updates user_maps.state to in_review with no transaction.
findings.failure: Second-query failure can leave a stored report while the map remains published.
findings.required: Report persistence and requeue state transition commit or roll back together.

findings.raw_368: approve/reject/unpublish update user_maps and then separately insert user_map_reviews with no transaction.
findings.failure: Audit insertion failure can surface an API error after the map state has already changed.
findings.required: State transition and review event commit or roll back together.
